name: William Salmon
bioAdditions: Southold town records (Liber A, printed vol. 1 pp. 169-170) recite that William Salmon married Katherine, widow of Mathew Sinderland, and 'after the decease of the said Katherine married with Sarah Hortton', and that he died intestate, his estate falling to Sarah and his children by both wives (S1). Sarah then married John Conklin Jr. (S1, S2).
